# D. James Poer — UX Engineer & Front-End Architect

> Professional portfolio of D. James Poer, a UX Engineer and Front-End Architect specializing in accessible enterprise applications, Angular, TypeScript, UX/UI, and AI-enabled product development.

This site documents James Poer's professional experience, technical work, portfolio projects, accessibility expertise, and product development work.

## Scope

The public case studies and work-history pages contain authorized career evidence.
The Thingamajob evaluator is an unfinished working prototype. Private career sources,
client records, test endpoints and evaluation inputs are not public source material.
